Stage and direct training entries reject before GPU imports, assets or Gaussian allocation.

Parent reconstruct stops at alignment-gate with an explicit non-training status; preprocessing was simulated only for this test.
A changed fitted artifact invalidates its recorded coarse-fit identity.
